import json, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
req = json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/req.json'))
flows=req['flows']; caps=req['capacities']; offers=req['offers']
n=len(flows)
ben=[]
for f in flows:
    kinds=f['kinds']; H=len(bytes.fromhex(f['template'])); nd=kinds.count('D'); N=len(f['path'])
    ben.append((H-4-nd)*N*sum(r['count'] for r in offers[f['id']]))
nodes=list(caps)
nm={}
for nd in nodes:
    m=0
    for i,f in enumerate(flows):
        if nd in f['path']: m|=1<<i
    nm[nd]=m
best=None; cnt=0
t0=time.time()
for mask in range(1<<n):
    cnt+=1
    ok=True
    for nd in nodes:
        if (mask & nm[nd]).bit_count() > caps[nd]: ok=False;break
    if not ok: continue
    b=0; mm=mask
    while mm:
        b += ben[mm.bit_length()-1]; mm &= mm-1
    key=(b,-mask.bit_count())
    if best is None or key>best[0]: best=(key,mask)
print('masks', cnt, 'time %.1f'%(time.time()-t0), 'best', best)
EOF
